newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Canada's Arakis Energy Corp announces major oil discovery in Sudan.
- Design contract for 470 million pound suspension bridge over Suez Canal signed in Cairo on Tuesday, economy minister says.
- Kuwaiti, Arab and U.S. business groups plan to set up company to invest in private companies and Arab monetary markets.
- Investors from United Arab Emirates buy Sheraton Hotel in Beirut for $53 million.
- Kuwait's Commerce and Industry Ministry studies proposal by private sector to establish public company to receive and resend satellite channels to subscribers.
